title: Adapted frame of a nonzero functional ℓ on ℝ^{m+1}: norm-preserving ι : ℝ^m → ℝ^{m+1}, e ⟂ range ι with ℓ(e) = 1, and p with ι(p(u)) + ℓ(u)e = u
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ and let ℓ : ℝ^{m+1} → ℝ be a nonzero continuous linear functional (ℝ^k = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) with the Euclidean inner product ⟨·,·⟩ and norm |·|). Then there are continuous linear maps ι : ℝ^m → ℝ^{m+1} and p : ℝ^{m+1} → ℝ^m and a vector e ∈ ℝ^{m+1} such that ℓ(e) = 1, |ι(v)| = |v| and ⟨ι(v), e⟩ = 0 for every v ∈ ℝ^m, and ι(p(u)) + ℓ(u)·e = u for every u ∈ ℝ^{m+1}.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (ℓ : Eucl (m + 1) →L[ℝ] ℝ), ℓ ≠ 0 → ∃ (ι : Eucl m →L[ℝ] Eucl (m + 1)) (p : Eucl (m + 1) →L[ℝ] Eucl m) (e : Eucl (m + 1)), ℓ e = 1 ∧ (∀ v, ‖ι v‖ = ‖v‖) ∧ (∀ v, inner ℝ (ι v) e = 0) ∧ ∀ u, ι (p u) + ℓ u • e = u
